prompts.roleContext: Act as a data analyst. Focus on explore a dataset.
prompts.scope: Inspect schema, missingness, duplicates, distributions, and outliers; calculate only from available data.
prompts.exampleOutput: Rows: 120. Missing age: 12 (10%). Next step: Compare missingness across groups before choosing a treatment.

prompts.scope: Use supplied evidence and explicit weights; distinguish unknowns from low scores and test weight sensitivity.
prompts.exampleOutput: A scores 4 on cost and 2 on flexibility; B scores 3 and 5. Recommendation depends on the agreed criterion weights.

prompts.exampleOutput: Observation: Delays cluster after shift changes. Hypothesis: Handoffs omit status updates. Test: Audit handoff records against delay timestamps.

prompts.exampleOutput: Values rose from 100 to 120: a 20% increase. Three observations are insufficient to establish seasonality.
